title: HOW TO #8: Build a Nest for a Giant Bird
caption:
How to build a nest for a giant bird 🦅🪺

A bird with a 3 meter wingspan needs a home. 10 problems, 10 fixes: ropes to the trunk, a bark roof, a wide landing platform with 2 supports, smooth metal against predators, dry grass and moss, a tilted floor for drainage, 6 roof ropes, a cleared flight path. A nest 8 meters high, strong enough for a 10 kilogram bird.

Would you build it higher or closer to the ground? Comment NEST below. Tag the friend who loves watching birds. Follow @StickMindR8 for HOW TO #9!
